camper.name: Camper
camper.description: The ideal class for new players, focused on baseline survival and ease of play.
camper.note: Verified price: 10 diamonds. Perks adapted for single-player.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.description: Finds more when searching buildings and chests.

medic.name: Medic
medic.description: Starts with medical supplies and heals faster.

fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.description: Starts holding a rod's worth of catch: fish to eat from day one.
fisherman.note: Verified price: 50 diamonds. Fishing rod adapted to a forage bonus near water.

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
lumberjack.description: Receives extra wood when felling trees.
lumberjack.note: Verified price: 70 diamonds. Wiki confirms Lumberjack gets extra wood.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Hits harder and runs faster, but hungers quicker.

chef.name: Chef
chef.description: Cooks unique seasoned recipes that grant large bonuses.
chef.note: Verified price: 150 diamonds. Chef's Station blueprint adapted to bonus stew output.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: A crafting specialist: grinds extra scrap and crafts at a discount.
blacksmith.note: Verified price: 200 diamonds. Wiki confirms grinder scrap bonus and craft discounts.

note: Prices verified against the reference wiki and GamesRadar class guide. Perk implementations are documented single-player adaptations; class level progression (I-III) from the original is not implemented.
